description: tab:prelowering figure rows, 2026-08-25. Uniform two-arm protocol: arm A (No Pre-Opt) = flat expand path (DEBUG_PROBPROG_DISABLE_OPT=true) + disable_licm_optimization_passes=true; arm B (Pre-Opt) = flat expand path + full standard passes. SICM off in both arms. 20 NUTS samples, adaptation off, CPU, median of 5 runs per cell after 1 warm-up call, no thread caps. FROZEN-ADAPTED-STATE: each model was first warmed up with adaptation ON (step size + mass matrix) in the Pre-Opt arm, and BOTH arms are then measured with adaptation OFF from that same saved step size, inverse mass matrix and post-warmup position, with matched seeds, so the arms walk bit-identical trajectories.
